records.master_outcome: A person checks shared text without manual copy-and-paste while retaining control of disclosure.
records.master_acceptance: Signed containing app and Share extension tested on real iPhones; bounded input, process lifecycle, consent, no unintended transfers, independent method parity and accessible results.
required_acceptance: Deliver Native iPhone sharing into a tag check. Next package action: Complete real iPhone/Android and screen-reader/offline update/removal checks. Required outcome: A person checks shared text without manual copy-and-paste while retaining control of disclosure.
records.precise_unmet_acceptance: Actual signed app/Share on iPhone14Plus with offline/VoiceOver/lifecycle/removal and outside-user operation remain missing.
records.next_authorized_technical_or_operating_a: Use current actual TestFlight1.0(1) with the owner; invited tester/no sessions is not acceptance.

records.title: Native Android sharing into a tag check
records.master_job: Receive selected text through an Android OS share interface with explicit user action.
records.master_outcome: A person checks shared text without manual copy-and-paste while retaining control of disclosure.
records.master_acceptance: Receive supported share intents on real Android devices; bounds, lifecycle, consent, no unintended transfers, independent method parity and accessible results.
required_acceptance: Deliver Native Android sharing into a tag check. Next package action: Complete real iPhone/Android and screen-reader/offline update/removal checks. Required outcome: A person checks shared text without manual copy-and-paste while retaining control of disclosure.
records.precise_unmet_acceptance: Actual physical Android/TalkBack/outside-user and maintained release/signing/startup coverage remain missing; API36 emulator is selected integration only.
records.next_authorized_technical_or_operating_a: Run the working Share build on legitimately available physical human-operated devices, retaining current startup/refusal limits.

records.title: Blind PS review from a phone
records.master_job: Read a frozen reviewer JSON file, collect independent labels and export exact item fields for comparison.
records.master_outcome: Reviewers can label without developer setup or detector predictions; incomplete and changed files fail coordinator comparison.
records.master_acceptance: Validate frozen hashes, reviewer slot, exact original text, unique complete items and reasons; show disagreements and ambiguity; forbid hidden predictions, uploads, automatic persistence and claims of verified independence.
required_acceptance: Recruit two independent humans and an independent sample coordinator; freeze a new representative holdout, return blind labels and adjudicate disagreement before detector evaluation. Phone packet tooling is complete but actual review is not.
records.precise_unmet_acceptance: Independent coordinator/two human reviewers/new representative blind holdout and human adjudication remain explicit.
records.next_authorized_technical_or_operating_a: Use frozen phone packets with actual independent participants; invented ratings remain engineering only.

limits: This audit adds no original IDs, changes no percentages/criteria and closes no scoped software task.
Current source/evidence hashes establish identity, not independent accuracy, professional approval or actual outside people.
Historical evidence paths are preserved as references; they were not all rerun or promoted to current proof.
No new tests, Docker, service, model/download, private user data, account grant or deployment used for this review.
Parent must select any future bounded implementation and review its exact functioning result before acceptance.
